description: Canonical token values for the swiss design system. Values are taken from the JSX source (canonical); see notes for derivations.

contrast_pairs.note: Primary actions render as red text on paper.
Builder text (8x, 13-14px; library/button-primary, patterns/auth-sign-in, patterns/drawer-right +5 more: 'Delete →', 'New thread →', 'New →') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (73x, 9-22px; library/accordion-default, library/accordion-expanded, library/badge-tag +34 more: '+8% this week', '/', '02') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (1x, 14-14px; library/button-disabled: 'Unavailable') renders as large_text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (6x, 14-14px; library/form-field-default, library/input-search, library/input-text +3 more: 'choose', 'search', 'type') renders as large_text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (3x, 9-13px; library/card-gray-surface, patterns/sidebar-default: '2M', 'CONTAINED CARD', 'No border, no radius.') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (7x, 9-13px; library/list-item-selected, library/table-row-selected, patterns/dashboard: '2M', 'ACTIVE', 'Administrator') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (8x, 9-14px; library/banner-info, library/banner-warning, library/dropdown-default +4 more: 'ATTENTION', 'ERROR', 'Please enter a valid ema') renders as text (#7 text coverage).

color.surface_inverse.note: Swiss never inverts surfaces in the JSX; the inverse pair is Ink (#000000) with Paper (#FFFFFF) text.

color.accent_foreground.note: JSX contrast table: 'Ink on Accent red 3.6:1'. Red is never a fill in Swiss (always type or a 2px bar). Contrast fix (#7): #000000 -> #FFFFFF. Black on red is 4.27:1. The signature red #E3000B stays (it is quoted throughout the rulebook); the foreground moves instead: the minimum passing value is #F5F5F5, snapped to Swiss white #FFFFFF (same as danger_foreground). Swiss never paints red as a fill, so this pair is latent. [color.accent_foreground on color.accent 4.27:1 -> 4.92:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.action.note: Primary buttons are red text with no fill ('Send ->'); the action/surface text pair is declared in contrast_pairs.

color.action_foreground.note: Same as accent_foreground; red fills are forbidden, so this pair is theoretical. Contrast fix (#7): #000000 -> #FFFFFF. See accent_foreground. [color.action_foreground on color.action 4.27:1 -> 4.92:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.danger.note: Swiss has one chromatic colour; danger reuses accent red #E3000B.

color.danger_foreground.note: Paper on red (4.9:1) rather than Ink (4.3:1).

color.success.note: No status hues in Swiss: status is '●' + tracked uppercase label, so success/warning/info fill with Ink and rely on the label.

color.border_input.note: Input is a 1px black top rule (JSX input.border-top 1px solid #000000).

color.focus_ring.note: JSX selection model: 'Focus outline 2px solid #000000 offset 2px'.

font.mono.note: Swiss forbids a second family; mono falls back to Inter.

extras.color.row_hover.note: Live CSS: sidebar row hover (.ci:hover) fill, one step lighter than surface_selected.

motion.fast.note: JSX .snd send affordance: 'transition: opacity 0.12s' (CSS default ease). Row selection is instant ('Transition: Instant — no animation'). exit_ms 0 is derived: the JSX has no exit animations (React unmounts instantly) and Swiss elements cut.

motion.moderate.note: JSX .ci list rows: 'fadeSlideUp 0.2s ease', 6px travel, 40ms stagger. exit_ms 0 derived (cut).

motion.slow.note: JSX .mi messages: 'fadeSlideUp 0.2s ease', 70ms stagger (doc row: 200ms ease, 70ms stagger). Equal to moderate: Swiss keeps every entrance at one short beat. exit_ms 0 derived (cut).

motion.expressive.note: No expressive motion: 'Swiss grids are static' (JSX don't: 'Add hover colour fills or animations'). Repeats slow.

motion.reduced_motion.note: The JSX has no prefers-reduced-motion query: every animation (including the staggered entrances) plays regardless of the user setting. Swiss is static by grammar, so reduced motion makes every transition instant.

color.text_muted.note: Contrast fix (#7 text coverage): #949494 -> #8E8E8E. The disabled button label on the grey surface_elevated (#F5F5F5) needs large_text 3:1 (swiss has no disabled-role fill token, so the disabled exemption does not apply); minimum OKLCH lightness change that passes, neutral grey kept. [color.text_muted on color.surface_elevated 2.78:1 -> 3.01:1 (min 3.0:1)]

hue_waivers.reason: ADR-0002 (owner decision): Swiss has exactly one chromatic colour and danger reuses the accent red #E3000B by design. Error states are carried by copy, not hue, as spec.yaml defines in components.error_message and the rulebook: error copy reads 'Error: <what failed>.' (swiss-error-prefix, mechanical), is set in ink, never red (swiss-error-not-red, mechanical), and uses no icon, shape, fill or border change (swiss-error-typographic). Red stays within its four contexts (swiss-red-finite-resource).
